main_text.l: est medium urbis punctum, ubi plærunq; forum esse
solet. Forum est frumentarium piscarium, suarium,
boarium, vinarium, olitorium, scrutarium, lignarium.
Radii a centro exeuntes sunt plateæ & viæ stratæ.
In urbibus præterea consideranda sunt, Curia,
ærarium, Schatzkammer, armamentarium, harnisch kam-
mer/cella vinaria, cerevisiaria, pharmacopolia, thea-
trum, porticus, basilica, Xenodochiū, ein gasthauß/
nosodochium, ein Frankenhauß / thermæ, balneæ,
templa cum cœmiteriis & epitaphiis, cœnobia, col-
legia cum Bibliothecis, & parœciæ, Die Gei[?] samlung
Derer so in eine Kirche gehö:en.
Quot sunt in Politia consideranda?
Species politiæ: utrum Monarchia sit, an Aristocra-
tia, an Timocratia. Item leges, judicia, genera num-
morum argenteorum & aureorum.
Quænam in incolis sunt considerandæ?
An cives sint an advenæ: qui eorum mores, qui ri-
tus, qui habitus, quæ ratio victus: quinam sint insi-
gnes divitiis, nobilitate, artibus vel bellicis, vel Me-
chanicis. An sint multi Theologi, Philosophi, Juris-
consulti, Medici.
Lecturus præcepta prolixiora, videat Zvingerum,
Hilarium, Pirckmajerum vel alios.
Hactenus fuit Apodemica exposita: sequitur de
Polemica.

page.notes: The black-letter words (Schatzkammer, harnisch, kammer, gasthauß, Frankenhauß, gehö:en) are German in fraktur; the spelling is as printed. The phrase "Die Gei[?] samlung" is doubtful: the word after "Die" is not clearly legible, so I have marked it [?]. The first word of the page is a fragment continuing from the previous page. The "D" at the foot is a gathering signature.
